decisions.statement: Initial configurable advanced budgets are 8 MiB selected input, 50000 input triples, 10 seconds/query, 500 result rows, 1 MiB query output, 30 seconds/reasoning, 100000 derived triples, 128 rule rounds, 10000 derivation nodes/result, two workers and 512 MiB RSS/worker. Guard evaluation uses at most 5 seconds. Measure memory-limit enforcement and overshoot on the supported host; unavailable enforcement blocks a profile claiming it. Preserve core 32000-byte output and Task 250000-byte/200-reference packet limits.

decisions.statement: Implement a finite, deterministic forward-rule profile for named class/subproperty propagation, class/property equivalence, approved individual equality, inverse, symmetric and transitive properties, plus explicit disjointness/negative-assertion conflict cases. Record proof DAGs with exact premises/rule IDs; use OWL-RL as a differential oracle for supported positive cases, not as unexamined proof output. Unsupported constructs fail explicitly; absent facts remain unproven and inconsistent components are quarantined from trusted results. This is a documented subset, not full OWL 2 RL conformance.
